intent: Complete the original privacy audit P2 requirement for same-model, same-fictional-prompt privacy-on/off comparison with separate detector, task-rubric and latency evidence. Retain the existing offline check and all production privacy authority.
acceptance: Only compiled fictional corpus case identifiers enter the provider binding; no real chat history, saved system prompt, private custom terms, attachments or tools.
Run is explicit; selection, expansion and composition send no request. One copied selected profile and equal bounded generation settings serve both arms.
The protected arm uses existing private turn, receiving authorization, route selection, final request validation and restoration; the generic unprotected benchmark guard remains unchanged.
Preserve real policy/profile change fences and cancellation. Unknown measurements, missing arms, failed warmups and incomplete generations cannot become task passes.

Read the current hydrated saved profile directly, preserve existing configured provider activation/permission guards around suspensions, and freeze the first warmup authority fingerprint across every subsequent leg.

Report actual known detector misses, altered public phrases, explicit task criteria, first-text/completion timings and actual optional usage separately; make no universal privacy or general semantic-quality claim.

Show nearest-rank p50/p95 with actual sample counts only for complete observed-runtime/output-ceiling matched pairs; group different configurations separately, use equal paired populations per answer-time metric, include completed rubric failures, and exclude warmups and unverified strict-route parity.
Both warmups are excluded from scored cases. Four cases use counterbalanced arm order; requests, output size and total run time are bounded.
Retain all shared-branch changes, run canonical checks and exact final-source ordinary project tests, merge only green and fully verify both successor publications.

Cancel the fictional provider comparison when its screen lifecycle stops or its composition is disposed; retain recorded and partial results, wait for provider cleanup, and require an explicit new Run after resuming.
